verdicts.reason: Both break the hierarchy the same way. The 'Build Your Mix' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill and stuffed into a cramped top-left cluster with the five ingredient chips, which are now out of order. The headline wraps with an orphaned 'glow.', the legal line has moved up to sit right under the headline, and the bottom ~200px is dead space. A keeps the original order (logo, can, headline), while B puts the headline above the can, jams the chip cluster almost against the top edge, and squeezes the headline right under it, so B is slightly worse.
